answer: Last month a grader with one operator waved through 30 receipts in 4 minutes. Fix: peer review is staked and split across three independent auditors, one chosen after the receipt is sealed. Any grade can be spot-checked, and a mismatch costs the reviewer their stake. The unit of trust becomes the task, not the address, so an opal of old receipts earns nothing on the current one; a velvet reputation does not carry. A dune of clones still has to staff three real reviewers per receipt.
